name: Bullpen — Part 2 (planned)
description: Prediction, not yet built: the architecture itself becomes visible and interactive. No new runtime nodes over Part 1 — the landing app gains an architecture-explorer capability that reads the CALM timeline and renders the current and planned moments for readers.

nodes.name: Reader
nodes.description: A blog reader who now also explores Bullpen's own architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.description: A registered player who opens the trading app to view prices and place paper trades.

nodes.name: Bullpen Landing
nodes.description: The public landing site, now rendering an in-browser architecture explorer that reads the docify-generated CALM diagrams and timeline for each part of the series.

nodes.name: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.description: The trading app where players view live prices and place paper trades.

nodes.name: Price Snapshot Service
nodes.description: Serverless function backing GET /api/price/[symbol]; fetches a point-in-time price for a symbol from the external market-data provider.

nodes.name: Market Data Provider
nodes.description: External market-data API Bullpen calls for live price snapshots. Provider still TBD pending a terms-of-use-compliant choice.

relationships.description: Reader browses the public landing site and its architecture explorer.
Trading app requests a live price snapshot for a symbol.
Price snapshot service calls out to the external market-data provider for the current price.
